title: Connecting the Dots Between Fact Verification and Fake News Detection

novelty_points.claim: 通过新闻摘要和预训练事实核验模型的串联，将事实核验能力迁移到零样本虚假新闻检测。
novelty_points.claim_en: Transfers fact verification to zero-shot fake news detection by composing news summarization with a pretrained fact verification model.
technical_features: 先用在新闻语料上预训练的摘要模型将长新闻压缩为短声明。
再使用在FEVER数据上预训练的事实核验模型检测新闻真伪。
采用零样本方式，减少对虚假新闻任务训练数据的依赖。
technical_features_en: First summarizes a long news article into a short claim with a model pretrained on news corpora.
Then uses a fact verification model pretrained on FEVER to detect whether the news is real or fake.
Enables zero-shot detection, reducing dependence on fake news training data.
